data.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 after weekly slide as oil, yields and security fear
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin recovered on Saturday but remained on course for a weekly loss, as rising oil prices, higher U.S. Treasury yields and renewed cryptocurrency security concerns weighed on sentiment.
